All the affixes to be treated of hereafter should be understood to come in the sense of past time.

Terms: भूत

The उणादि affixes are seen also attached with the force of the past time.

Terms: उणादि

And (where there is a reason for affixing लिङ् (Benedictive) , the affix ऌङ् (Conditional Future) is to be used, when the non-completion of the action is to be understood) if the sense is that of past time.

Terms: ऌङ्

The affix चर (with the feminine in ङीप्) comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem), the word retaining its detonation when the meaning is 'this had been before'.

Terms: चर
